chunks.content: ## Elastic Band Production Using True Fold Back in CLO This section explains the step-by-step process of creating a realistic elastic waistband using the True Fold Back technique in CLO, focusing on arranging pattern pieces, sewing lines, and using the setting layer tool for proper layer positioning. ### Arranging and Sewing Waist and Elastic Band Versions - Begin by opening the arrangement points on the 3D model. - Arrange the waist pattern piece (waist version) on the model. - Adjust the frame arrangement of the waist version in the attribute editor to position it correctly. - Close the arrangement points once the waist version is properly placed. - Sew the waist and skirt pieces together as a base. - Designate the basic line on the waist version as the internal sewing line. - Add the elastic band pattern piece (elastic band version) alongside the waist version. - Add the sewing line connecting the elastic band version to the inside of the waist version. - In the 3D window, fold the waist version back using the fold arrangement function. - Hook the other side of the internal sewing line to complete the seam. - Fill in the sewing line to secure the connection. ### Using the Setting Layer Tool for Proper Layer Placement - To keep the elastic band version positioned inside the waist version, use the setting layer tool. - The elastic band version should be placed inside the reverse side of the waist version. - This means the elastic band version appears on the outside of the opposite side of the waist version. - Understanding the relationship between the setting layer and the opposite side of the pattern piece is crucial. - Set the elastic band version layer relative to the waist version by selecting the elastic band version first, then the waist version. - Change the layer operation from the plus button (+) to the minus button (−) to place the elastic band version on the opposite side of the waist version. - This immobilizes and stabilizes the waist version in the simulation. ### Simulation and Quality Improvement - Open the simulation to observe the stability of the waist version with the elastic band inside. - The waist version will settle and remain stable, though occlusions may make some parts difficult to select. - Apply "back juice" (likely a translation or term referring to fold or tuck refinement) to the waist version to enhance folding quality. - Improve the quality of the elastic band fold to make it finer and stand higher. - Attach the elastic band at the waistband position to complete a realistic and high-quality elastic waistband. This process results in a properly constructed elastic waistband with realistic folding and stable layering, essential for producing uniform clothing in CLO.
